ai_analysis.summary: This promotional post presents Python interview questions attributed to American Express for a Data Analyst role with 0–3 years of experience. The listed tasks cover Pandas DataFrame operations, including duplicate detection, combining DataFrames, ranking salaries, employee-manager self-merges, anomaly and fraud-pattern detection, reshaping, datetime processing, growth calculations, and performance optimization. It also mentions numba, itertools, collections.Counter, and collections.defaultdict. The post advises candidates to think in terms of DataFrames and write clean, readable logic, but it does not provide worked answers or detailed explanations of the functions.

Combining DataFrames with merge(), join(), and concat()
Top-N selection and ranking with nlargest() and rank()
Employee-manager comparisons using a Pandas self-merge
Using apply(), map(), lambda, and np.where()
Anomaly and fraud-pattern detection with conditional logic
Reshaping and pivoting with pivot(), pivot_table(), melt(), and stack()/unstack()
Datetime parsing, component extraction, and time-based filtering
Year-over-year and month-over-month growth with shift() and pct_change()
Data handling with itertools, collections.Counter, and collections.defaultdict
